title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Fillmore Auditorium, Denver | 2003
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Fillmore Auditorium in Denver, Colorado, USA, on 27 August 2003.

It was the 27th show by the eighth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 35 dates between July and September 2003.

The eighth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Paul Carrack: vocals, guitar, keyboards
  • John Waite: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, guitar, bass, harmonica, flute
  • Sheila E: vocals, drums, percussion

  • It Don’t Come Easy
  • ‘Honey Don’t’
  • ‘Memphis In Your Mind’
  • ‘How Long’ (Paul Carrack)
  • ‘Down Under’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Isn’t It Time’ (John Waite)

  • ‘Photograph’

  • ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’
